protocol.population: Deterministic laboratory fixtures, not an observed player cohort

vendorComparatorSources.name: Trader Wilkes
vendorComparatorSources.title: Provisioner
vendorComparatorSources.greeting: Fresh bread, clean water, fair prices. What can I get you?

vendorComparatorSources.name: Weaver Ottilie
vendorComparatorSources.title: Master of the Loom
vendorComparatorSources.greeting: Mind the threads, $C. A steady hand at the loom beats a strong one.

vendorComparatorSources.name: Tanner Hesk
vendorComparatorSources.title: Master of the Tannery
vendorComparatorSources.greeting: A hide is only as good as its tanning, $C. The vats are ready when you are.

vendorComparatorSources.name: Quartermaster Finch
vendorComparatorSources.title: Camp Outfitter
vendorComparatorSources.greeting: My counter keeps exactly one thing for sale, $N: a spare pouch for what you pick up along the way, when your lesson calls for it. Everything else here is salvage bound for the vale. Coin buys the pouch, and work earns the coin. That is the whole economy, and it never gets more complicated. Only bigger.
